info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Payment Management API
info.description: The Loan Payment Management API enables users to manage payments associated with specific loans. This operation allows for the removal of a payment using its unique identifier, fostering accurate tracking and accountability in loan payment records. Typical consumers include financial institutions, loan services, and accounting software that require precise management of payment transactions. By providing this capability, the API supports streamlined financial operations and enhances user control over payment histories.

delete.summary: Delete a specific payment from a loan.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a specific payment associated with a particular loan. By providing the loan and payment identifiers, you can effectively manage the loan's payment history.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific payment associated with a loan. Ensure that the payment identifier is valid and the loan exists before proceeding with the deletion.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

DeleteLoanPaymentLOAN500045PAY300045Requ.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a payment operation related to a specific loan. It is expected to contain the necessary data in string format.
